featured.title: Nayyi Navelli (2026)
featured.description: A new bride's arrival turns a turbulent household in Meerut into a picture of domestic harmony, until her brother-in-law grows convinced that his seemingly perfect sister-in-law is secretly a witch.

movies.title: Aakhri Sawal (Hindi Dub)
movies.description: Vicky, a brilliant but volatile scholar who ignites a national firestorm when he publicly accuses his legendary mentor, Professor Gopal Nadkarni, of institutional bias. What begins as a faculty dispute is quickly hijacked by a sensationalist news anchor and an ambitious political activist, turning a private disagreement into a televised "intellectual trial" watched by millions.

movies.title: Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata (Hindi Dub)
movies.description: Inside Cama Hospital, one of the sites targeted during the 2008 Mumbai terror attacks, nurses, ward boys, cleaners, lift operators, security personnel, and administrative workers keep 400 people alive while armed assailants struck the city around them.

movies.title: The Great Grand Superhero: Aliens Ka Aagman (Hindi Dub)
movies.originalTitle: The Great Grand Superhero: Aliens Ka Aagman [Hindi]
movies.description: Follows a grandfather and grandson whose relationship transforms through the child's imagination when they encounter aliens.

movies.title: Babita Singh Reporting (Hindi Dub)
movies.description: People-pleasing cop Baby accepts a fake charge to get leave for her sister-in-law’s baby shower in Rewa. There, she reunites with her childhood friend Bansi, who is murdered that very night. Defying dismissive in-laws, an indifferent husband and an apathetic local police force, she secretly investigates the murder, uncovering family betrayals while finding her own voice, courage and place as a real cop.

movies.title: Cocaine Bear (Hindi Dub)
movies.description: Inspired by a true story, an oddball group of cops, criminals, tourists and teens converge in a Georgia forest where a 500-pound black bear goes on a murderous rampage after unintentionally ingesting cocaine.

movies.title: The India Story (Hindi Dub)
movies.description: A community confronts the devastating impact of pesticide contamination as industrial negligence threatens public health. The fight for accountability exposes systemic failures in regulatory oversight and corporate responsibility.

movies.title: Baby Do Die Do (Hindi Dub)
movies.description: A deaf and mute serial killer in Mumbai can only hear her dead sister's voice as she commits murders for mysterious reasons.

movies.title: Ohh My Dog (Hindi Dub)
movies.description: In Assam, 14-year-old Apu embarks on a desperate quest to rescue his beloved dog, Momo, after he is kidnapped. Elsewhere, in Bihar, a devoted dog named Oscar sets out on a perilous journey to find his kidnapped owner, a 15-year-old child labourer. As their journeys unfold, it becomes clear that the two kidnappings may be connected to a larger, sinister plan.

movies.title: Bandar (Hindi Dub)
movies.description: TV star Samar's life spirals when his ex Gayatri accuses him of rape after he blocks contact with her. Despite his new relationship with Khushi, he faces arrest and encounters a corrupt justice system.

movies.title: Gandhari (Hindi Dub)
movies.description: When a mother loses her eyesight and her daughter in a kidnapping, she takes matters into her own hands to hunt down those responsible.

movies.title: Cocktail 2 (Hindi Dub)
movies.description: A vacation in Sicily forces longtime partners Diya and Kunal to question their love and commitment after they reunite with Diya's old friend Ally.

movies.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle (Hindi Dub)
movies.description: Four teenagers in detention discover an old video game console with a game they’ve never heard of. When they decide to play, they are immediately sucked into the jungle world of Jumanji in the bodies of their avatars. They’ll have to complete the adventure of their lives filled with fun, thrills and danger or be stuck in the game forever!

movies.title: Alpha (Hindi Dub)
movies.description: When Sita, a highly trained assassin raised in isolation as a super-soldier by a rogue commander, discovers the dark truth about her family and her stolen childhood, she teams up with her long lost sister to take down her creator and his illicit military program.

cast.name: Bobby Deol
cast.character: Fateh Singh Lakhawat / Major Zarrar Khan

movies.title: Dhamaal 4 (Hindi Dub)
movies.description: The Dhamaal boys are back for another treasure hunt, facing hilarious challenges in their quest for the Treasure of Life.

movies.title: Ghamasaan (Hindi Dub)
movies.description: Set in the Hindi heartland, the story follows a cat and mouse chase against a ruthless dacoit. An honest IPS officer is determined to hunt him down, corrupt politicians notwithstanding.

movies.title: Awarapan 2 (Hindi Dub)
movies.description: Once a feared gangster, Shivam lives hidden away from his past, with no faith left in God or himself. But when fate pulls him into Bangkok's cartel war and forces him back into the darkness he swore never to return to, Shivam must choose what he is willing to live for, when there is nothing left to lose.

movies.title: Masterplan (Hindi Dub)
movies.description: When a legendary thief sets his sights on the Mona Lisa, he recruits two young strangers to help him before revealing they are long-lost siblings… and oh yes, by the way, he is their father. Thrown into a chaotic reunion they never asked for, this new family must learn to work together — and try not to kill each other — if they want any chance at pulling off the heist of the century.

movies.title: Sacrifice (Hindi Dub)
movies.description: During a star-studded charity gala brimming with celebrities, billionaires, and empty speeches, a movie star in the midst of an existential crisis is taken hostage by a radical warrior and her devoted followers. As the night descends into chaos, both an inward journey and an outward adventure ensue, where the line between performance and belief, salvation and sacrifice, begins to blur.

movies.title: Moana (Hindi Dub)
movies.description: Teenage Moana answers the Ocean's call and, for the first time, voyages beyond the reef of her island of Motunui with infamous demigod Maui on an unforgettable journey to restore prosperity to her people.

movies.title: Mandaadi (Hindi Dub)
movies.description: A fishing captain applies his maritime knowledge in a traditional boat race along Tamil Nadu's coast during a festival, leading a six-person team against other crews.

movies.title: Khalifa: The Ruler (Hindi Dub)
movies.description: Aamir Ali, a notorious gold smuggling kingpin who inherited his multi-million dollar criminal enterprise from a lineage of gangsters, is drawn into a web of vengeance, legacy and power.

movies.title: The Paradise (Hindi Dub)
movies.description: In 1980s Secunderabad, a marginalized tribe battles discrimination and fights for citizenship under an unexpected leader's guidance, challenging systemic oppression.

movies.title: Main Ladega (Hindi Dub)
movies.description: A young boy escapes his troubled home, finding solace I in boxing at an army hostel, where he channels his pain into strength to protect his family.

movies.title: Pooja Meri Jaan (Hindi Dub)
movies.description: After Pooja rejects Aniket’s romantic advances, his subsequent death by suicide leaves her facing accusations. As lawyer and friend Sana investigates the circumstances surrounding the incident, questions of obsession, consent, responsibility and the truth behind Pooja’s relationship with Aniket begin to emerge.

movies.title: DC (Hindi Dub)
movies.description: From avenging his mother’s murder to battling police corruption, Das becomes a fugitive after a deadly heist. Amid a trail of bloodshed and loss, he frees Chandra from a life of exploitation, and she gives him a reason to seek a life beyond violence.

movies.title: Jailer 2 (2026)
movies.description: When a dangerous syndicate expands its reach to threaten his family's peace, retired jailer Tiger Muthuvel Pandian goes undercover as a driver. Operating from the shadows, he takes on ruthless new enemies to protect his home.

movies.title: Nayyi Navelli (2026)
movies.description: A new bride's arrival turns a turbulent household in Meerut into a picture of domestic harmony, until her brother-in-law grows convinced that his seemingly perfect sister-in-law is secretly a witch.

movies.title: Lust Stories 3 (2026)
movies.description: Through four bite-sized yet emotionally resonant films, the anthology once again explores lust, love, relationships, and repressed desire, offering fresh perspectives on intimacy, longing, and human connection in all their complexity.

movies.title: The End of Oak Street (2026)
movies.description: After a mysterious cosmic event rips Oak Street from suburbia and transports their neighborhood to someplace unknown, the Platt family soon discovers that their very survival depends on them sticking together as they navigate their now unrecognizable surroundings.

movies.title: Resident Evil (2026)
movies.description: Medical courier Bryan unwittingly finds himself fighting for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.

movies.title: Street Fighter (2026)
movies.description: In 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu and Ken Masters are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don't, it's GAME OVER!

movies.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
movies.description: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

movies.title: Colony
movies.description: Professor Se-jeong is thrust into a bloody nightmare when a rapidly mutating virus is released during a biotech conference causing authorities to seal the facility. Trapped inside with no escape, Se-jeong along with a small group of survivors must fight to stay alive while the infected undergo horrific transformations.
Yoon-young, a 19-year-old girl who dreams of becoming a civil servant, is framed as a murderer and imprisoned in a women's prison.

movies.title: A Tale of Two Sisters
movies.description: Two sisters return home after a stay in a mental institution, only to face disturbing events and a strained relationship with their stepmother. As eerie occurrences unfold, dark family secrets begin to surface, blurring the line between reality and nightmare.

movies.title: A Man and a Woman
movies.description: Two strangers have dropped their kids off at a pickup area for a children's camp in Helsinki, Finland. A spark of mutual interest is ignited between the man and woman.

movies.title: A Hard Day
movies.description: After trying to cover up a car accident that left a man dead, a crooked homicide detective is stalked by a mysterious man claiming to have witnessed the event.

movies.title: A Company Man
movies.description: A contract killer becomes disenchanted with his line of work and spares the lives of his two latest would-be-victims. But the assassination company he works for has no intentions of letting him quit.

movies.title: 20th Century Girl
movies.description: In 1999, a teen girl keeps close tabs on a boy in school on behalf of her deeply smitten best friend – then she gets swept up in a love story of her own.

movies.title: 12.12: The Day
movies.description: On December 12, 1979, in Seoul, South Korea, military officers staged a military rebellion following the assassination of President Park Chung-hee. Defense Security Commander Chun Doo-gwang leads an unauthorized insurrection to seize control of the military and government, while stubborn Capital Defense Commander Lee Tae-shin risks his life to resist the treason and defend the republic.

series.title: Make Me Tingle (Ongoing)

episodes.title: Episode 04 - Episode 4

series.title: Love in Disguise (Ongoing)
series.description: [Ongoing Series - 2 Episodes Released] Taekang Group's successor, Yoon Yi-jun, is the prime suspect of a shocking murder. To uncover the truth, Kang Jae-hee goes undercover as a male secretary to keep an eye on Yi-jun. The closer they get to what really happened, the closer Yi-jun and Jae-hee become. Will Jae-hee, who is hiding her identity, and Yi-jun, who is hiding a secret, be able to let their true feelings be known to one another?

episodes.title: Episode 01 - Episode 1
episodes.overview: Taekang Group's successor, Yoon Yi-jun, is suspected of murdering his secretary, but the group's power and lack of evidence impede the investigation. To find key evidence, special forces-turned-detective Kang Jae-hee applies to be his secretary, not as a woman but as a man! She manages to get the job, but Yi-jun doesn't let his guard down. Jae-hee risks getting exposed on her first day at work.

episodes.title: Episode 02 - Episode 2
episodes.overview: Kang Jae-hee's double life begins. She's Yoon Yi-jun's secretary by day and a detective by night. Yi-jun keeps testing her, but Jae-hee relentlessly keeps an eye on him and searches for the missing phone. She plans to infiltrate the room that's banned from entering, but Yi-jun doesn't let his guard down easily. Their relationship takes a strange turn through unexpected physical contact.

series.title: A Killer Paradox
series.description: When one accidental killing leads to another, an ordinary young man finds himself stuck in an endless cat-and-mouse chase with a shrewd detective.

series.title: 365: Repeat the Year
series.description:
A story where ten people get the chance to go back in time by one year, but unexpectedly mysterious situations start to arise when their fates are changed and twisted in the process.

Ji Hyung Joo is a detective in the violent crimes division. He used to be part of the traffic police but was promoted when he arrested a wanted criminal.

It's been seven years since the change, and he's a talented individual who always knows how to relax. Though he is happy at first to have the chance to go back in time by one year and "reset" his life, he begins to search for the truth when a series of mysterious events befall on the group of people he goes back in time with. Based on the Japanese novel, "Repeat"

series.description: The drama tells the story of a man whose life takes a downward spiral after his fiance dies just days before their upcoming marriage.

Their romantic lives begin when the boy they liked in their youth shows up one day. They live in Oksu-dong in rundown apartments, and the warm human drama will be about neighborly affection, and the meaning of home, family, and friendship.
